map.5!=5×4×3×2×1=120；0!=1（约定，使公式自洽，如 C(n,0)=: 5! = 5×4×3×2×1 = 120; 0! = 1 (a convention that keeps the formulas consistent, e.g. C(n,0)=1).
map.20!≈2.43×10^18，超过 64 位整数上界；更大阶乘需用对数或近似（斯: 20! ≈ 2.43×10^18, beyond the 64-bit integer limit; larger factorials need logarithms or an approximation (Stirling's formula n! ≈ √(2πn)(n/e)^n).
map.这是约定也是组合含义：从 n 个里选 0 个只有 1 种方式（什么都不选），且使: It is both a convention and a combinatorial meaning: choosing 0 out of n has only 1 way (choosing nothing), and it keeps C(n,0)=n!/(0!×n!)=1 consistent.
map.阶乘增长有多快？: How fast does the factorial grow?
map.极快，近似指数中的指数级。10!=3628800，20! 已超 2×10^18，: Very fast, roughly exponential-of-exponential. 10! = 3628800, and 20! already exceeds 2×10^18, far beyond the ordinary integer range, so large values need logarithms or approximation.
map.阶乘 n! = 1×2×…×n（0!=1），表示 n 个不同元素的全排列数；增长: The factorial n! = 1×2×…×n (0!=1) gives the number of permutations of n distinct elements; it grows extremely fast — 13! already exceeds 6 billion.
map.普通数值类型在 n≈170 附近溢出；大数阶乘需高精度/对数近似（log(n!): Ordinary numeric types overflow around n≈170; large factorials need high precision or a logarithmic approximation (log(n!)). This tool computes within its supported range and warns when exceeded.

Validation: n>170 prompts "n cannot exceed 170: 171! already exceeds the double-precision floating-point limit (about 1.8×10³⁰⁸)" and stops. Criteria: no fixed grading; n! grows faster than exponential, 70! already exceeds 10¹⁰⁰, and 170! is the largest representable in double precision.
